name: Preparar Consulta 60 s + vw_baseline_24h
PG SELECT Janela 60 s
query:
SELECT t.*,
       COALESCE(b.baseline_mu_presenca, 12.0) AS baseline_mu_presenca,
       COALESCE(b.baseline_sigma_presenca, 2.5) AS baseline_sigma_presenca
FROM telemetria_sensores t
LEFT JOIN vw_baseline_24h b ON TRUE
WHERE t.capturado_em >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
ORDER BY t.capturado_em ASC;
